text: On Saturday, Kilmarnock will begin their season with an away match against Brora Rangers, a team from the Highland League. This match not only marks the manager's inaugural competitive game in his role, but also serves as the debut for the nine new players he has recruited thus far.
Kilmarnock eased to a two-goal win over Highland League champions Brora Rangers in Stuart Kettlewell's first competitive game in charge.
Kilmarnock will now start their season on Saturday away to Highland League champions Brora Rangers in the League Cup group stage.
